ops.title: ccx vcs ship's "multiple nearest bookmarks" is stale worktree bookmarks, not a lane bug
ops.body:
Root cause found 2026-07-30 while cleaning up after the Phase D step 2/3 landing.

`ccx vcs ship` refused every invocation in this repo for a full session with:

    multiple nearest bookmarks "main, worktree-wf_0adb6670-7d6-1,
    worktree-wf_6f0707d4-36b-1, worktree-wf_a580fcaf-ec5-1";
    pass --branch <name> to choose one

The cause is entirely local state: three `Agent`/`Workflow` worktrees under
.claude/worktrees/ each left a `worktree-<id>` jj bookmark pointing at a commit
near @, so ship's nearest-bookmark resolution saw four candidates. Removing the
worktrees (`git worktree remove --force`) and deleting the bookmarks
(`jj bookmark delete`) restored ship immediately — `ccx vcs info` went from the
ambiguity error to a clean `lane jj / branch main`. A fourth bookmark,
worktree-agent-a76797bdb095ed6c3, had outlived its worktree entirely.

So the operational lesson: worktree-isolated workflow lanes leave bookmarks
behind, and enough of them silently disable ship. Clean up worktrees when the
lane lands, not "later".

The papercut's own complaint still stands as a separate ccx bug: --branch main
and --bookmark main BOTH reproduced the identical error, so the message
prescribes a remedy that does not work. Worth reporting upstream with this root
cause attached — the flag should override nearest-bookmark resolution outright.
